about: R2-SOUND S0b (design_docs/planned/r2/sound.md §D8): recipes rendered by the sunholo/audio package (pinned in tools/audio/ailang.toml; schema sunholo.audio.recipes/1, parsed under this file's own id). 48 kHz mono 16-bit; loops complete whole cycles; peak_db is the file's peak, the cue table sets the level.

recipes.about: The spire: low, slow, slightly beating (55 Hz against 55.25 Hz); harmonics to 440 Hz so laptop speakers carry it. Constant, never tied to the drive.
D-108: the spire's second, longer beat (a 32 s cycle) with a slight grit, under the hum. It fades in as the Archive's Memory Health falls.
D-108: the badly degraded layer: the long beat roughened, wavering and gritty, a tone that does not belong (137.5 Hz). It takes over as Memory Health becomes critical.
v2 (D-108: 'really annoying'): barely there. A soft, low body of air and structure under the dome, almost no hiss; the hum leads.
A short, dry interface click.
Back or cancel: a click that falls.
Confirm: two quick tones a fourth apart.
v2 (D-108: 'bit silly'): a latch, a soft low thunk, a fluttering servo opening up, and a faint settle; lower and quieter, more machine than toy.
v2 (D-108: 'too perky'): the servo closes down and the latch settles; nothing rises.
v2 (D-108: 'too jolly'): an understated suspended chord (G, C, D), low and soft, in commit_seal's mood: you have arrived, nothing is celebrated.
The commit is accepted: one low-mid open chord, settling. It sounds final because it is.
Holding to commit: a tone that rises for the 1.5 s hold (the game stops it on release).

v2 (D-108: 'too high, not complex enough'): lower (220 to 275 Hz) and richer: detuned partials beating slowly, an inharmonic voice, a noise band whose filter opens. Still the teacup rule: nothing below 200 Hz, nothing felt.
v2 (D-108: 'too high'): the drive settles low and fades; the noise band closes until only the hum and the room are left.
v2 (D-108: 'too pure'): the boost's mirror, falling 275 to 220 Hz, rougher: three voices rubbing, faster beats, more air and a little grit. No rumble.
The ship turns at a stop: a soft navigation tone, no thruster hiss (nothing leaves the bubble but light).
The dust counter: one dry tick per grain that flashes on the dome.
v2 (D-108: 'bit boring'): a small breathing three-note figure (D, A, E) with a glassy shimmer; soft and in-world, a voice clearing its throat without speaking.
A plan meets the drive's hold limit: two soft pulses, an alert, not an alarm.

S1 v4 (D-123: v3 'still sound aggressive ... has to be pleasant-ish ... not banging in the skull'): a step felt more than heard, under the hum. A dark padded thud (three-pole low-pass white noise, most energy 120-300 Hz), a soft body, a barely-there brush; a rounded 32 ms attack and a smooth 90 ms decay, no transient. S1: the lift's latch lets go and its motor spins up.
S1: the lift's motor while the platform travels (a loop that rides with it).
S1: the platform settles with a soft clunk and one old brass bell (a single low note, not a jingle).

R3-EARTH-LINK EL3b.7: sound from home, family. A room of voices, low and warm, never words; the room's air under it. 5 s loop. v3 (R3-SUNHOLO-AUDIO-REALISM, sunholo/audio 0.6.0): three talkers (a jittered glottal buzz through moving vowel formants, a syllable at a time, seeded), in a small room, over a quiet brown room tone

EL3b.7: home, the house and the valley. Wind in the leaves over a low garden air. 5 s loop. v3 (R3-SUNHOLO-AUDIO-REALISM, sunholo/audio 0.6.0): brown garden air; two gusts (pink through a rising band, wrapping); leaves as scattered short pink rustles that breathe with the wind

EL3b.7: the town. A street's voices and feet, traffic far off, a little brightness in the air. 5 s loop. v3 (R3-SUNHOLO-AUDIO-REALISM, sunholo/audio 0.6.0): two walkers' steps (fixed times, a soft heel through resonant bands), a car passing far off, far talkers in the street's echo, brown traffic rumble

recipes.about: EL3b.7: the world. A large crowd far off, rising and falling. 5 s loop. v3 (R3-SUNHOLO-AUDIO-REALISM, sunholo/audio 0.6.0): a crowd of ten talkers' syllables, low-passed and far, in a big space, over a vowel-coloured pink wash

recipes.about: EL3b.7: science and space. A lab's carrier hum, a fan and one slowly pulsing instrument tone. 5 s loop; whole cycles. v3 (R3-SUNHOLO-AUDIO-REALISM, sunholo/audio 0.6.0): the hum and the pulse kept; the fan is pink air with its blade-pass tone (7 blades at 20 rev/s: 140 and 280 Hz)

EL3b.7: the sky over home. Night air and crickets. 5 s loop. v3 (R3-SUNHOLO-AUDIO-REALISM, sunholo/audio 0.6.0): three crickets, each a chirp of 3-4 pulses of a 4-5 kHz tone at its own rate (Dolbear's law: about 20 C), outdoors, over brown night air

EL3b.7: the torrent. Weeks of home flicking past: a babble of voices and the twitter of tunes and bells. 5 s loop. v3 (R3-SUNHOLO-AUDIO-REALISM, sunholo/audio 0.6.0): dense short syllables from six talkers, scattered FM chime fragments and plucked notes

recipes.about: EL3b.7: no signal. A faint receiver hiss, the sound of the static on the picture. 5 s loop. v3 (R3-SUNHOLO-AUDIO-REALISM, sunholo/audio 0.6.0): pink receiver hiss in the receiver's band, a low brown rumble, scattered crackle (1-3 ms clicks, 12 dB of variation) under the hiss

EL3b.7 accent: a few soft notes of a tune from the next room (G B D B A G), a music box. Calm, not jolly. v3 (R3-SUNHOLO-AUDIO-REALISM, sunholo/audio 0.6.0): take A: struck steel tines (fundamental + cantilever-beam modes 6.27 and 17.55, a tiny click), heard through a wall in a small room

EL3b.7 accent: birds in the garden, two short phrases of rising chirps. v3 (R3-SUNHOLO-AUDIO-REALISM, sunholo/audio 0.6.0): the same phrases with a fast warble on each chirp, then a short descending trill, in open air

EL3b.7 accent: church bells across the town, two strikes (bell partials: hum, prime, minor-third tierce, quint, nominal). v3 (R3-SUNHOLO-AUDIO-REALISM, sunholo/audio 0.6.0): the same partials plus a Chowning FM strike (ratio 1.4, index 8 -> 0), far off: low-passed, with the square's long echo

EL3b.7 accent: a crowd far off swells and settles (a march, a final, a treaty's square). Neither cheer nor jeer. v3 (R3-SUNHOLO-AUDIO-REALISM, sunholo/audio 0.6.0): the home_world crowd under one swelling envelope, with its wash, far off
